rus-terem-11.see: A rectangular log-walled room with wooden plank flooring features an entryway door at the bottom, wall benches, and a central dining table on an ornate patterned rug set with a mug, roll, and cup beside a carved armchair.
rus-terem-11.culture: Slavic / Russian, medieval to early modern
rus-terem-11.focal: Wooden dining table on a patterned rug
rus-terem-11.wrong: A bright lime-green horizontal bar at the top edge; a green piece of furniture clips through the lower-left wall boundary; a cradle or shelf clips into the upper-right corner; walls are cut off at half-height with no ceiling.

rus-church-11.see: A log-walled wooden chapel features an entryway door at the bottom, a two-tiered wooden iconostasis along the back wall, a wooden lectern displaying an icon on the right, and two tall freestanding multi-candle stands.
rus-church-11.culture: Eastern Slavic / Russian Orthodox, medieval to early modern
rus-church-11.wrong: A lime-green horizontal bar at the top edge; miniature icon faces and text are unreadable; a light-green plane clips above the center of the iconostasis; cutaway walls with no ceiling.

rus-yard-11.see: A wood-planked yard or utility room bounded by log walls and a wattle gate contains a wooden well with a counterweighted sweep mechanism, flanked by stacked firewood, a bench, a trough-bed, and tree foliage.
rus-yard-11.culture: Slavic / Russian rural, medieval to traditional
rus-yard-11.focal: Well sweep (shadoof) with bucket and counterweight
rus-yard-11.wrong: A full outdoor well sweep mechanism is built directly atop indoor wooden floor planks; leafy tree foliage clips directly through the right log wall; a green wedge artifact appears at the top left below the debug overlay; cutaway walls.

rus-banya-11.see: A compact log-walled bathhouse features stepped wooden sauna benches with red cloths on the left, a stone stove topped with rocks and wooden tubs on the right, and birch bath whisks hanging on the rear wall.
rus-banya-11.culture: Slavic / Russian (traditional banya), medieval to early modern
rus-banya-11.focal: Stone sauna stove (pech) topped with heating rocks
rus-banya-11.wrong: A small wooden water bowl in the middle of the floor appears slightly ungrounded; the stone wood-burning stove has no chimney or exhaust flue inside the enclosed wooden room; green artifact at the top left; cutaway walls with no ceiling.

rus-market-11.see: A small log-walled shop contains an entryway door, a shelving unit and chest on the left, and a central wooden sales counter bearing a balance scale, two cheese wheels, and a cake.
rus-market-11.culture: Slavic / Russian, medieval to early modern
rus-market-11.focal: Shop counter with balance scale and cheese wheels
rus-market-11.wrong: A small framed slate board clips awkwardly into the chest on the left; balance scale pans hang slightly tilted with no weights; green artifact sliver at top left; cutaway walls with no ceiling.

rus-izba-11.see: A cozy log-walled living room contains an entryway door at the bottom, a large masonry stove with a bed on top in the left corner, a hanging cradle, wall benches, a central round braided rug, and a dining table set with food on the right.
rus-izba-11.culture: Slavic / Russian folk (peasant izba), medieval to early modern
rus-izba-11.focal: Russian masonry stove (pech) with sleeping platform
rus-izba-11.wrong: The cradle hangs from the wall with no visible ceiling attachment point or suspension rope; a chest clips into the plaster base of the stove and left wall; a loose bundle of kindling sits isolated in the middle of the floor planks; green artifact at top edge; cutaway walls with no ceiling.
